# Context Pack: `cli-dispatch-exit-contract` — CLI dispatch and exit-code envelope contract Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: operator-interfaces. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose `cmd/ultraplan/main.go:18-43` wires OS argv/stdout/stderr, a signal context (`signal.NotifyContext` on SIGINT/SIGTERM, main.go:19), and the TUI/web runner adapters into `app.Run`, then exits with its integer return (`os.Exit`). `app.Run` (internal/app/app.go:88-178) is the single admission point for every invocation: it normalizes nil streams to `io.Discard` (stdout/stderr) or `os.Stdin` (stdin), defaults version and workdir, constructs the process-wide `runControlState` closed via defer (app.go:108-109), parses global flags, and dispatches one of 15 arms — `--help/-h`, `version`, and 13 command words (`init-workspace`, `defaults`, `skills`, `config`, `health`, `storage`, `run`, `project`, `sprint`, `study`, `tui`, `serve`, `code`) — at app.go:144-177; anything else is ExitUsage. The surface owns the numeric exit-class vocabulary (0-8, app.go:15-25), the stable-code strings derived from classes (`errorCode`, app.go:67-86), the classified-error wrapper that carries both a display string and an exit class (`classedError`, app.go:41-65), the stderr one-liner printer (`fail`, app.go:229-241), the shared JSON envelope writer (`json_output.go`), and the per-command renderers/flag grammars in `*_commands.go`. Scripts and agents consume three things: process exit codes, stdout bytes, and stderr bytes; docs/cli-reference.md declares those contracts. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 Global admission `parseGlobalFlags` (app.go:198-220) extracts only `--workspace ` / `--workspace=` (rejecting missing or dash-prefixed values) and passes all other tokens through in order; no other global flags exist. Empty argv, `--help`, `-h` print `renderHelp()` to stdout and exit 0 (app.go:140-146); unknown first token exits 2 with a pointer to `--help` (app.go:175-176). Every handler returns a single `error`; `failOrOK`/`fail` (app.go:222-241) print `err.Error()` as one stderr line and return the wrapped `classedError.class`, falling back to ExitError(1) for unclassed errors (including raw I/O write errors returned by handlers). `writeStatus` (app.go:243-248) returns ExitError if the stdout write itself fails. ### 2.2 Verb families - **Pure text inspectors** (no workspace mutation): `version` (app.go:147-148 → `renderVersion`), `config show [--json]` (config_commands.go:10-119; ~60 fixed `key: value` lines plus `(source: …)` provenance annotations; redaction applied before rendering), `project list|

status|

validate` (project_commands.go:10-75; validate findings are printed to **stderr**, project_commands.go:118-129, and any findings force ExitValidation). - **Workspace writers**: `init-workspace [--path --dry-run]` (workspace_commands.go), `defaults install [--path --dry-run --force]` (defaults_commands.go), `skills materialise [stage] [--path --dry-run --force]` accepting the `materialize` alias (skills_commands.go:17-23). All three print operation plans (`created/would create/overwrite/skip file …`) and use ExitWorkspace for failures. - **Durable-store door**: `run list|show|follow|cancel|diagnostics` (run_commands.go:19-40) — full behavior is the run-cli-observation pack's subject; this surface owns its arg parsing conventions (`std flag.FlagSet` with output discarded, `helpRequested` pre-check, `orderRunArgs` hand-rolled flag/positional reordering for show/follow/cancel/diagnostics, run_commands.go:463-481) and its error→class mapping `mapRunControlError` (403-414): ErrInvalidArgument→2, ErrNotFound→5, ErrConflict/ErrTerminal→8, everything else→6. - **Study/sprint product verbs** (§2.3-2.4): large hand-rolled positional+flag grammars over `study.Service` / `sprint.Service`. - **Frontends**: `tui` (tui_commands.go:21-61) and `serve` (serve_commands.go:18-99) build `dashboardUseCases`/`NewWebUseCases`, open the run-control repository, and delegate to injected runners; `serve` validates `--listen` as a numeric loopback IP:port *before* workspace discovery (ValidateLoopbackListen, serve_commands.go:119-139; test-enforced ordering serve_commands_test.go:51) and maps shutdown-time context cancellation to exit 0 (serve_commands.go:62-64, 92-97). - **Utility**: `storage migrate [--dry-run] [--json]` (storage_commands.go:33-140) imports study/sprint state files into SQLite and exits ExitPartial when any item failed (136-138); `code ... [--json] [--output]` (code_commands.go:19-78) maps extraction status Validation→5 / Partial→8. ### 2.3 Sprint verb grammar (sprint_commands.go) `runSprint` (28-566) requires ` `; `conformance-review` is aliased to `review` in-place (77-79). Help checks are position-sensitive (args[3]/args[4]). Per verb: - `status [--json]` (90-121): renders status; smoke-readiness failure categories `catalog`/`review_gate` downgrade the JSON `status` label to `"partial"` but still exit 0. - `metrics [--json]` (122-141): bare service DTO encoded directly (no envelope fields beyond the struct). - `validate ` (142-179): ten stages incl. execute/review/smoke; invalid stage → usage; failed validation → ExitValidation after printing findings. - `prompt [--explain]` (180-222): prints the rendered prompt verbatim to stdout; `--explain` emits explanation JSON instead. - `flow --to […]` (223-279): requires `--yes` for non-dry-run smoke targets (234-235); non-dry-run wraps work in `beginDurableCLICommand`; error classification ladder at 256-273: findings present → ExitValidation regardless of cause; else **`strings.Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime** (269-272); else `mapSprintError`. - `verify […]` (280-328): same durable wrap; typed smoke errors go through `mapSmokeError`, others `mapSprintError`; assessment fail/blocked forces ExitValidation (325-327). The verify payload is emitted even on failure, with `status` taken from `result.Verification.Assessment` and an added `error` object from `stableCommandError` (313-318). - `execute […]` (329-368): durable wrap skipped for dry-run and for `--defer` (defer runs outside the durable boundary, 349-350); classification ladder 356-366: findings → 5; **`Contains(err.Error(), "failed tasks")` → ExitPartial**; **`Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime**; else mapSprintError. - `qa [map|status|recover|cancel|run|resume]` (369-466): parser enforces flag/action compatibility (588-640, e.g., cancel requires `--run`, forbids `--shard`); run/resume take the durable path with QA writer-token handoff; progress callbacks print `[qa] …` to **stderr** with redacted messages (435-441); the JSON envelope `{schema_version, operation:"sprint.qa", status, result, error?}` is written to **stdout even on failure** (454-459), with `error` built by `stableQACommandError` (category, retryable, correlation_id, recovery, timestamp). - `review […]` (467-512): durable wrap unless dry-run; verdict fail or status blocked → ExitValidation; **`Contains(err.Error(), "runtime")` → ExitRuntime** (507-509); else mapSprintError. - `smoke […]` (513-562): `--yes` mandatory for non-dry-run (518-520); typed `mapSmokeError` decides everything (879-892): category cancellation→7, process/timeout/cleanup→6, all other typed categories→5; untyped falls back to mapSprintError; verdict fail/blocked → ExitValidation. Shared mappers: `mapSprintError` (944-963) orders `context.Canceled`→7, `DeadlineExceeded`→6, `ErrVerificationConflict`→8, flow-state and execute-state sentinels→5, project/sprint RefError→5, default→ExitWorkspace(4). `mapQACommandError` (662-679) maps canceled/deadline→**ExitPartial(8)** with codes `qa.cancelled`/`qa.deadline_exceeded`, QA-typed runtime/persistence→6 with codes `qa.`, other QA categories→5, fallback→mapSprintError. `stableCommandError` (1463-1470) reduces any classed error to `{code, message, recovery}` where message passes through `displaySafe` (usecases.go:251-278: config redaction + ANSI/control-char stripping). ### 2.4 Study verb grammar (study_commands.go, study_runs_commands.go) `runStudy` (26-120) routes `init | list | list | {summary, validate, status, runs, run-loop, run-all, run, synthesize, prompt}`; sub-verbs are matched positionally (`args[1]=="run-loop"` etc.). Runtime-backed verbs (`run-loop`, `run-all`, `run`, `synthesize`) wrap execution in `beginDurableCLICommand` and classify results afterwards: `classifyRunAllResult` (732-745) completed→0, cancelled→7, partial→8, runtime-failed→6, otherwise→5; `classifyExecutionResult` (933-948) completed/skipped→0, runtime-failed→6, cancelled→7, validation-failed/preflight-blocked→5, unknown status→ExitError(1). Read-only doors: `status [--json]` uses the shared envelope with `statusJSONResult` (status_json.go:67-145 — counts, redacted lock command, per-task usage/cost as `{known,value}` pairs, workspace-relative paths); `validate [--json]` uses the shared envelope with redacted checks and returns ExitValidation when failed (1012-1044); `summary`/`runs summary` regenerate artifacts and return 0 unless resolution/history sync fails. Error mappers: `mapStudyError`/`mapStudyPromptError`/`mapStudySummaryError` (RefError/config sentinels→5, default→4), `mapStudyRunLoopError` (locked→8, malformed/unsupported→5, else execution mapper), `mapStudyStatusError` (1162-1178 — missing/malformed→5, else→4, with a `displayError` wrapper whose display string has absolute paths rewritten relative via `strings.ReplaceAll`). ### 2.5 Durable acceptance coverage (dispatch-level contract) `beginDurableCLICommand` (durable_operations.go:49-60) opens the repository, accepts an outer operation row with an **empty alias digest** (so alias dedup is unreachable from CLI, durable_operations.go:55), claims it, appends a lifecycle-running event, and hands back a cancellation-aware context. CLI call sites: sprint flow/verify/execute/review/smoke/qa-run/qa-resume (6 textual call sites) and study run-loop/run-all/run/synthesize (4). Dry-run, prompt, validate, status, metrics, qa map/status/recover/cancel, storage, run-observation, and all foundation verbs skip acceptance. `finishDurableCLICommand` (86-91) joins the run error with `Finish`, which classifies the terminal outcome (ctx-done→cancelled, deadline→timed_out, err→failed, else succeeded) under a fresh 30 s `context.Background()` window so terminal persistence survives parent cancellation, and surfaces finish failure as a classed ExitRuntime error joined into the result. `TestEveryRuntimeBackedCLIEntryUsesDurableAcceptanceInventory` (run_control_inventory_test.go:11-55) pins these call-site counts and kind strings by reading the source files. ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: `os.Args[1:]`; env vars read via `envLookup` (`ULTRAPLAN_WORKSPACE`, `ULTRAPLAN_STUDY_MODEL` studyModelOverride study_commands.go:183-188, QA/smoke settings via effective config, smoke `Getenv` injection sprint_commands.go:814-823); stdin for the three confirmation prompts (§5); filesystem state behind discovery/validation; wall clock (`timeNow` var, study_commands.go:1160, used in envelope timestamps and status reconciliation). Outputs, by stream: - **stdout**: help/version text; all human result renderers; all JSON envelopes and NDJSON (`run follow --json`); interactive prompts and their echoes for defaults/skills/run-loop-reset confirmations; `[run-loop]` task-progress lines (the documented exception to stderr-progress discipline, cli-reference.md:32); `serve` startup messages. - **stderr**: exactly one line per failed command via `fail()`; sanitized progress streams for sprint flow/verify/execute/review/smoke/qa and study run-all/run/synthesize (`[sprint]`, `[runtime]`, `[smoke]`, `[qa]` prefixes; redacted via `config.RedactValue`); project-validate findings; non-completed-task and warning summaries after study runs; serve diagnostics. - **exit code**: one of {0..8}; ExitError(1) is reachable only through write failures, unclassified handler errors, `serve`/`tui` runner failures, code-render failures, and the unknown-status arm of `classifyExecutionResult`. Envelope families (all schema_version 1): 1. Shared `writeJSON` envelope `{schema_version, command, workspace, status, generated_at, result}` (json_output.go:20-31): `config show`, `health`, `study validate`, `study status`, `run list/show/diagnostics` (diagnostics sets `status` to `string(health.Status)` rather than constant "ok"). 2. Ad-hoc command envelopes `{schema_version, operation, status, result, error?}` encoded inline: `sprint status/flow/verify/qa/review/smoke` (and `metrics` emits the bare DTO without wrapper fields). 3. Deterministic domain JSON: `code --json` (`codeextract.RenderJSON`), `storage migrate --json` (`storageMigrationResult` struct). Failure-path emission varies: health writes its envelope with status "fail" before returning the error (health_commands.go:46-50); sprint flow/verify/qa write failure envelopes best-effort (`_ =` discard of encode errors, e.g., sprint_commands.go:259, 318, 459); most other verbs emit nothing on stdout when failing. ## 4. Authoritative state None durable is owned here. This surface is projection/admission only: it creates no tables, holds no locks beyond what delegated layers acquire, and persists nothing except through delegated effects (files written by init/defaults/skills/study-init/code-output/prompt-output/storage-migrate; rows written via beginDurableCLICommand and runRepository; listener socket in serve). Process-local state: `runControlState` singleton (per-workspace repository+logger, closed at Run exit), the `durableOperationManager` created per accepted command (owned-operation map, control goroutine), and the injectable `timeNow`. The authoritative stores it touches belong to other surfaces: `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (run-journal-fencing), flow-state/execute-state/QA files (sprint-flow-state, sprint-qa-investigation), run-state.json (study-runloop-scheduler), product-state DB (product-state-mirror). ## 5. Invariants (as implemented) - One admission function; every exit path flows through `fail`/`writeStatus` so each command produces at most one stderr line and a single class from {0..8}. - Classified errors preserve their cause chain (`Unwrap`, app.go:48) so `errors.Is/As` ladders operate on original sentinels/typed errors while the class rides on the wrapper. - Stable code strings per class (`errorCode`); QA adds a finer `qa.` code vocabulary carried inside JSON payloads (phase3-json-schemas.md:35 closed list). - Interactive confirmations have no TTY detection anywhere: `confirmOverwriteDefaults` (defaults_commands.go:125-144), `confirmOverwriteSkills` (skills_commands.go:148-167), and `confirmRunLoopReplacement` (study_commands.go:277-316) read one line from configured stdin; EOF is tolerated (treated as a non-affirmative answer); non-"yes/y" answers keep existing files or refuse replacement (replacement refusal exits ExitPartial "replacement not confirmed", study_commands.go:314). Destructive non-interactive paths require explicit flags instead: `--force` (defaults/skills), `--reset --yes` (run-loop), `--yes` (smoke/flow-to-smoke/verify-to-smoke), `--force-review --override-reason` pairs enforced at parse time (sprint_commands.go:873-876, 1070-1072, 1187-1189). - Stream discipline as documented: runtime-backed sprint progress → stderr; final results → stdout; study run-loop progress → stdout by documented exception; human errors → stderr. - Durable acceptance precedes runtime work for exactly the inventory-pinned entry set; acceptance happens after parse/discover/config so malformed invocations never create runs. - Terminal proposal after cancellation uses a detached context, so a cancelled command still records its durable outcome when persistence is reachable. - Redaction before display on every renderer that embeds potentially sensitive values (`config.RedactValue` calls across config/health/study/sprint/QA renderers); `displaySafe` additionally strips ANSI escapes/control bytes for JSON-embedded messages. ## 6. Trust boundaries - All argv tokens, env vars, and stdin answers are untrusted admission input. They reach: workspace/config loading (validated downstream by config-inspection-health), file paths for init/defaults/skills/code-output/prompt-output (`--output` for study prompt is containment-checked via `workspace.ResolveInside`, study_commands.go:1409; `code --output` is not contained, only made absolute against workDir, code_commands.go:56-65), model refs (`--model`, passed through to runtime request construction), listen address (strictly validated loopback-only), and identifiers echoed into error strings (e.g., `%q` of unknown commands/stages). - Error text is inspected by classifiers: the sprint flow/execute/review ladders branch on substrings of `err.Error()` ("runtime", "failed tasks") produced by lower packages; everything else classifies via typed sentinel/`errors.As` matches. A parallel guard exists for the TUI/web operation path asserting free-form text does not affect classification there (sprint_error_test.go:29-41); the CLI substring branches are separate code. - Error text also reaches consumers: `fail()` prints `err.Error()` verbatim to stderr (causes are app-constructed; several embed user-supplied tokens quoted); JSON envelopes embed only `displaySafe`-processed messages; `stableCommandError`'s fixed `recovery` string is constant. - Confirmation prompts accept any stdin bytes; only exact `yes`/`y` (case-insensitive, trimmed) affirm. - The `serve` door inherits web-security-boundary controls; dispatch contributes the loopback-listen validation and never forwards raw argv further. ## 7. External effects & lifecycle semantics External effects per invocation can include: workspace scaffold/default/skill file creation or overwrite (with confirm/force gates); git clone subprocesses during `study init` (partial failures → ExitPartial with redacted clone output, study_init_commands_test.go:113); SQLite DB/schema creation (`storage migrate` non-dry-run opens runcontrol + productstate); durable run rows/events/terminals in run-control.db for accepted verbs; report/prompt/output file writes; a listening loopback socket and optional platform browser launch (`openBrowser`, main.go:45-62, exec of `open`/`rundll32`/`xdg-open` with 5 s timeout); TUI takeover of stdout. Cancellation semantics: the process-level context derives from SIGINT/SIGTERM. For durable-wrapped verbs, cancellation propagates through the accepted operation's child context; `Finish` records cancelled/timed_out terminals; `mapSprintError` yields exit 7 for plain cancellation while the QA command path deliberately yields exit 8 with code `qa.cancelled` (both behaviors test-pinned). `serve` treats shutdown cancellation as success (exit 0) after drain. `run follow` ends observation-only on ctx-done (exit 0). Non-durable verbs simply unwind; partial side effects (e.g., half-written scaffolds) are not compensated anywhere in this layer. Retry semantics: none at this layer — no handler retries on failure; retryability is expressed only as data (`retryable` booleans in QA error payloads; typed store-error flags consumed elsewhere). Restart semantics: stateless between invocations; every invocation re-runs discovery/config and (for repository-opening verbs) startup reconcile owned by deeper surfaces. The surface owns the numeric exit-class vocabulary (0-8, app.go:15-25), the stable-code strings derived from classes (`errorCode`, app.go:67-86), the classified-error wrapper that carries both a display string and an exit class (`classedError`, app.go:41-65), the stderr one-liner printer (`fail`, app.go:229-241), the shared JSON envelope writer (`json_output.go`), and the per-command renderers/flag grammars in `*_commands.go`. Scripts and agents consume three things: process exit codes, stdout bytes, and stderr bytes; docs/cli-reference.md declares those contracts. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 Global admission `parseGlobalFlags` (app.go:198-220) extracts only `--workspace ` / `--workspace=` (rejecting missing or dash-prefixed values) and passes all other tokens through in order; no other global flags exist. Empty argv, `--help`, `-h` print `renderHelp()` to stdout and exit 0 (app.go:140-146); unknown first token exits 2 with a pointer to `--help` (app.go:175-176). Every handler returns a single `error`; `failOrOK`/`fail` (app.go:222-241) print `err.Error()` as one stderr line and return the wrapped `classedError.class`, falling back to ExitError(1) for unclassed errors (including raw I/O write errors returned by handlers). `writeStatus` (app.go:243-248) returns ExitError if the stdout write itself fails. ### 2.2 Verb families - **Pure text inspectors** (no workspace mutation): `version` (app.go:147-148 → `renderVersion`), `config show [--json]` (config_commands.go:10-119; ~60 fixed `key: value` lines plus `(source: …)` provenance annotations; redaction applied before rendering), `project list|

status|

validate` (project_commands.go:10-75; validate findings are printed to **stderr**, project_commands.go:118-129, and any findings force ExitValidation). - **Workspace writers**: `init-workspace [--path --dry-run]` (workspace_commands.go), `defaults install [--path --dry-run --force]` (defaults_commands.go), `skills materialise [stage] [--path --dry-run --force]` accepting the `materialize` alias (skills_commands.go:17-23). All three print operation plans (`created/would create/overwrite/skip file …`) and use ExitWorkspace for failures. - **Durable-store door**: `run list|show|follow|cancel|diagnostics` (run_commands.go:19-40) — full behavior is the run-cli-observation pack's subject; this surface owns its arg parsing conventions (`std flag.FlagSet` with output discarded, `helpRequested` pre-check, `orderRunArgs` hand-rolled flag/positional reordering for show/follow/cancel/diagnostics, run_commands.go:463-481) and its error→class mapping `mapRunControlError` (403-414): ErrInvalidArgument→2, ErrNotFound→5, ErrConflict/ErrTerminal→8, everything else→6. - **Study/sprint product verbs** (§2.3-2.4): large hand-rolled positional+flag grammars over `study.Service` / `sprint.Service`.

Interesting things already:

1. In `app.go:176`: `classified(ExitUsage, "unknown command %q\n\nRun 'ultraplan --help' ...")` — this error message contains a literal `\n\n`. `fail()` prints `err.Error()` with `Fprintln` — so stderr will contain 3 lines for an unknown command, violating the "exactly one line per failed command" stream discipline claim in the context pack §5 invariant ("each command produces at most one stderr line"). Let me check: the invariant says "every exit path flows through fail/writeStatus so each command produces at most one stderr line". The unknown-command path emits a multi-line message. Is that a contract violation? docs/cli-reference.md — need to check what it says about stderr. This is minor though. But it's a documented invariant in the pack; whether docs promise one-line errors needs checking.

2. `parseGlobalFlags`: `--workspace` value starting with `-` is rejected. But note: `--workspace=` empty rejected. What about `--workspace` appearing multiple times? Last wins. Fine.

3. Note that global flag parsing happens over ALL args including subcommand flags. So `ultraplan sprint foo bar --workspace=x`? Wait no, `--workspace` after subcommand would be extracted globally too since parseGlobalFlags scans all tokens. E.g., `ultraplan code report.md --workspace=/tmp/x` — the `--workspace` would be consumed as global and removed from the args passed to runCode. Hmm, could that conflict with a per-verb flag named --workspace? Need to check per-verb grammars for their own `--workspace` flags. Probably not.

4. `writeStatus(stdout, renderHelp())` — if stdout write fails → ExitError(1). OK.

5. `fail()` writes err.Error() via Fprintln; if write fails → ExitError. OK.

6. `errorCode(class)`: default returns "internal.error" — includes ExitOK (0)? errorCode is only called with nonzero classes presumably. ExitError=1 → default → "internal.error". OK.

7. Interesting: `deps.workDir == ""` fallback silently to "" when os.Getwd fails (pack unknown #11). Where is workDir used? For relative path resolution e.g., code --output made absolute against workDir; workspace Discover StartDir "". If Getwd fails, StartDir="" — behavior of Discover with empty start dir? Might fall back to cwd anyway or fail. Minor.

332: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
333: 		}
334: 		execService := service
335: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
336: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
337: 		if !req.DryRun && req.DeferReason == "" {
338: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationExecuteStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "execute", Task: req.TaskID})
339: 			if err != nil {
340: 				return err
341: 			}
342: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
343: 			execService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
344: 			if err != nil {
345: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
346: 			}
347: 		}
348: 		var result sprint.ExecuteResult
349: 		if req.DeferReason != "" {
350: 			result, err = execService.DeferExecuteTask(deps.ctx, args[0], args[1], req.TaskID, req.DeferReason)
351: 		} else {
352: 			result, err = execService.Execute(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
353: 		}
354: 		err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
355: 		renderSprintExecute(deps, result)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			if len(result.Findings) > 0 {
358: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
359: 			}
360: 			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "failed tasks") {
361: 				return classified(ExitPartial, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
362: 			}
363: 			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "runtime") {
364: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
365: 			}
366: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.execute", err)
367: 		}
368: 		return nil
369: 	case "qa":
370: 		qa, settingsErr := qaSettings(effective)
371: 		if settingsErr != nil {
372: 			return classified(ExitConfig, "qa.config: %w", settingsErr)
373: 		}
374: 		qaService := service.WithQASettings(qa)
375: 		qaCommand, parseErr := parseSprintQAArgs(args[3:])
376: 		if parseErr != nil {
377: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.qa: %w", parseErr)
378: 		}
379: 		operationStatus := "ok"
380: 		var qaResult QAResult
381: 		var runErr error
382: 		switch qaCommand.Action {
383: 		case "map":
384: 			mapped, mapErr := qaService.QAMap(args[0], args[1])
385: 			runErr = mapErr
386: 			if mapErr == nil {
387: 				qaResult = qaMapProjection(mapped.Map)
388: 			}
389: 		case "status":
390: 			snapshot, statusErr := qaService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
391: 			runErr = statusErr
392: 			if statusErr == nil {
393: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
394: 			}
395: 		case "recover":
396: 			snapshot, recoverErr := qaService.RecoverQA(deps.ctx, args[0], args[1])
397: 			runErr = recoverErr
398: 			if recoverErr == nil {
399: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
400: 			}
401: 		case "cancel":
402: 			repository, _, repositoryErr := runRepository(deps)
403: 			if repositoryErr != nil {
404: 				runErr = repositoryErr
405: 				break
406: 			}
407: 			useCases := dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, runs: repositoryRunUseCases{repository: repository}}
408: 			cancelled, cancelErr := useCases.CancelQA(deps.ctx, QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], RunID: qaCommand.RunID})
409: 			runErr = cancelErr
410: 			qaResult = cancelled.QA
411: 			if cancelErr == nil {
412: 				qaResult.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("cancellation requested=%t run=%s; %s", cancelled.Requested, cancelled.Run.RunID, qaResult.NextAction)
413: 			}
414: 		case "run", "resume":
415: 			kind := OperationQAStart
416: 			if qaCommand.Action == "resume" {
417: 				kind = OperationQAResume
418: 			}
419: 			durable, durableErr := beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: kind, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Task: qaCommand.Shard})
420: 			if durableErr != nil {
421: 				runErr = durableErr
422: 				break
423: 			}
424: 			token, fence, ownershipErr := durable.QAWriterToken()
425: 			if ownershipErr != nil {
426: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, ownershipErr)
427: 				break
428: 			}
429: 			runtimeService, serviceErr := sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
430: 			if serviceErr != nil {
431: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, serviceErr)
432: 				break
433: 			}
434: 			runtimeService = runtimeService.WithQAWriterFence(fence)
435: 			_, qaErr := runtimeService.RunQA(durable.Context(), args[0], args[1], sprint.QARunRequest{Resume: qaCommand.Action == "resume", FocusShard: qaCommand.Shard, WriterToken: token, Progress: func(progress sprint.QAProgress) {
436: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[qa] %s %d/%d", progress.Phase, progress.Completed, progress.Total)
437: 				if progress.ShardID != "" {
438: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.ShardID)
439: 				}
440: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", config.RedactValue("qa.progress", progress.Message))
441: 			}})
442: 			runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, qaErr)
443: 			snapshot, statusErr := runtimeService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
444: 			if statusErr == nil {
445: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
446: 			} else {
447: 				runErr = errors.Join(runErr, statusErr)
448: 			}
449: 		}
450: 		if runErr != nil {
451: 			operationStatus = "failed"
452: 		}
453: 		qaResult = (dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, readOnly: true}).withQAConformanceReview(QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1]}, qaResult)
454: 		if qaCommand.JSON {
455: 			payload := map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.qa", "status": operationStatus, "result": qaResult}
456: 			if runErr != nil {
457: 				payload["error"] = stableQACommandError(mapQACommandError(runErr), runErr, qaResult)
458: 			}
459: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(payload)
460: 		} else {
461: 			renderSprintQA(deps, qaResult)
462: 		}
463: 		if runErr != nil {
464: 			return mapQACommandError(runErr)
465: 		}
466: 		return nil
467: 	case "review":
468: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintReviewArgs(args[3:])
469: 		if err != nil {
470: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.review: %w", err)
471: 		}
472: 		reviewService := service
473: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
474: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
475: 		if !req.DryRun {
476: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.ReviewProgress) {
477: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[sprint] Conformance Review coverage %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
478: 				if progress.CoverageID != "" {
479: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.CoverageID)
480: 				}
481: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", progress.Message)
482: 			}
483: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationReviewStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "review", RestartReview: req.Restart})
484: 			if err != nil {
485: 				return err
486: 			}
487: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
488: 			reviewService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
489: 			if err != nil {
490: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 		result, runErr := reviewService.Review(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
494: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
495: 		if jsonOut {
496: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.review", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
497: 		} else {
498: 			renderSprintReview(deps, result)
499: 		}
500: 		if runErr != nil {
501: 			if result.Verdict == sprint.ReviewFail {
502: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
503: 			}
504: 			if result.Status == sprint.ReviewBlocked {
505: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
506: 			}
507: 			if strings.Contains(runErr.Error(), "runtime") {
508: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
509: 			}
510: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.review", runErr)
511: 		}
512: 		return nil
513: 	case "smoke":
514: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintSmokeArgs(args[3:])
515: 		if err != nil {
516: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: %w", err)
517: 		}
518: 		if !req.DryRun && !req.NonInteractive {
519: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: --yes is required for non-interactive external harness execution")
520: 		}
521: 		if !req.DryRun {
522: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.SmokeProgress) {
523: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[smoke] %-20s", progress.Phase)
524: 				if progress.Test != "" {
525: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " test=%s", progress.Test)
526: 				} else if progress.Suite != "" {
527: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " suite=%s", progress.Suite)
528: 				}
529: 				if progress.Total > 0 {
530: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
531: 				}
532: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " | %s\n", config.RedactValue("smoke.progress", progress.Message))
533: 			}
534: 		}
535: 		smokeService := service
536: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
537: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
538: 		if !req.DryRun {
539: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationSmokeStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "smoke", Level: string(req.Level), Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test})
540: 			if err != nil {
541: 				return err
542: 			}
543: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
544: 			smokeService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
545: 			if err != nil {
546: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
547: 			}
548: 		}
549: 		result, runErr := smokeService.RunSmoke(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
550: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
551: 		if jsonOut {
552: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.smoke", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
553: 		} else {
554: 			renderSprintSmoke(deps, result)
555: 		}
556: 		if runErr != nil {
557: 			return mapSmokeError(runErr)
558: 		}
559: 		if result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeFailVerdict || result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeBlockedVerdict {
560: 			return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.smoke: verdict %s; %s", result.Verdict, result.NextAction)
561: 		}
562: 		return nil
563: 	default:
564: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint: unsupported command %q", args[2])
565: 	}
566: }

568: func stripFlag(args []string, flag string) ([]string, bool) {
569: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(args))
570: 	found := false
571: 	for _, arg := range args {
572: 		if arg == flag {
573: 			found = true
574: 			continue
575: 		}
576: 		out = append(out, arg)
577: 	}
578: 	return out, found
579: }

588: func parseSprintQAArgs(args []string) (sprintQACommand, error) {
589: 	command := sprintQACommand{Action: "run"}
590: 	if len(args) > 0 {
591: 		switch args[0] {
592: 		case "status", "resume", "cancel", "recover":
593: 			command.Action = args[0]
594: 			args = args[1:]
595: 		}
596: 	}
597: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
598: 		switch args[i] {
599: 		case "--dry-run":
600: 			if command.Action != "run" {
601: 				return command, fmt.Errorf("--dry-run cannot be combined with %s", command.Action)
602: 			}
603: 			command.Action = "map"
604: 		case "--json":
605: 			command.JSON = true
606: 		case "--shard":
607: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
608: 				return command, errors.New("--shard requires a map-owned shard ID")
609: 			}
610: 			command.Shard = args[i+1]
611: 			i++
612: 		case "--run":
613: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
614: 				return command, errors.New("--run requires a durable run ID")
615: 			}
616: 			command.RunID = args[i+1]
617: 			i++
618: 		default:
619: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("unknown QA argument %q", args[i])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 	switch command.Action {
623: 	case "run", "resume":
624: 		if command.RunID != "" {
625: 			return command, errors.New("--run is valid only with qa cancel")
626: 		}
627: 	case "cancel":
628: 		if command.RunID == "" {
629: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel requires --run")
630: 		}
631: 		if command.Shard != "" {
632: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel does not accept --shard")
633: 		}
634: 	case "map", "status", "recover":
635: 		if command.Shard != "" || command.RunID != "" {
636: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("qa %s does not accept --shard or --run", command.Action)
637: 		}
638: 	}
639: 	return command, nil
640: }

642: func renderSprintQA(deps dependencies, result QAResult) {
643: 	if result.Phase == string(sprint.QAPhaseCompleted) {
644: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA completed")
645: 	} else {
646: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA")
647: 	}
648: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  sprint: %s/%s\n  phase: %s\n  fresh: %t\n", result.Project, result.Sprint, result.Phase, result.Fresh)
649: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  Conformance Review: status=%s verdict=%s fresh=%t\n", result.ConformanceReviewStatus, result.ConformanceReviewVerdict, result.ConformanceReviewFresh)
650: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  coverage: %d/%d changed paths\n  shards: %d/%d\n", result.CoveredPaths, result.ChangedPaths, result.CompletedShards, result.TotalShards)
651: 	for _, outcome := range []string{"confirmed", "refuted", "invalid", "inconclusive", "blocked", "cross_shard", "not_applicable"} {
652: 		if count := result.OutcomeTotals[outcome]; count > 0 {
653: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  theories.%s: %d\n", outcome, count)
654: 		}
655: 	}
656: 	if result.Blocker != nil {
657: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  blocker: %s (%s)\n", result.Blocker.Summary, result.Blocker.Category)
658: 	}
659: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  next: %s\n", result.NextAction)
660: }

662: func mapQACommandError(err error) error {
663: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
664: 		code := "qa.cancelled"
665: 		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
666: 			code = "qa.deadline_exceeded"
667: 		}
668: 		return classedError{class: ExitPartial, code: code, err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
669: 	}
670: 	if typed, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
671: 		class := ExitValidation
672: 		switch typed.Category {
673: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
674: 			class = ExitRuntime
675: 		}
676: 		return classedError{class: class, code: "qa." + string(typed.Category), err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
677: 	}
678: 	return mapSprintError("sprint.qa", err)
679: }

685: func sprintRuntimeService(deps dependencies, root workspace.Root, observers ...func(sprint.RuntimeProgress)) (sprint.Service, error) {
686: 	effective, err := loadEffectiveConfig(root, deps, config.CLIOverrides{})

689: 	}
690: 	req, err := runtimepkg.RequestFromConfig(effective.Config, root.Path)
691: 	if err != nil {
692: 		return sprint.Service{}, classified(ExitConfig, "runtime.config: %w", err)
693: 	}
694: 	rt, err := deps.sprintRuntimeFactory(effective.Config)
695: 	if err != nil {
696: 		return sprint.Service{}, classified(ExitRuntime, "runtime.init: %w", err)
697: 	}
698: 	controlled, err := controlledRuntimeFor(deps, root.Path, effective.Config, rt)
699: 	if err != nil {
700: 		return sprint.Service{}, classified(ExitRuntime, "run-control.init: %w", err)

711: }

713: func qaSettings(effective config.Effective) (sprint.QASettings, error) {
714: 	c := effective.Config.QA
715: 	model := strings.TrimSpace(c.Model)
716: 	modelSource := effective.Sources["qa.model"]
717: 	if model == "" {
718: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.ReviewModel)
719: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.review_model"]
720: 	}
721: 	if model == "" {
722: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.PlanModel)
723: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.plan_model"]
724: 	}
725: 	if model == "" {
726: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Models.Default)
727: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["models.default"]
728: 	}
729: 	variant := strings.TrimSpace(c.Variant)
730: 	variantSource := effective.Sources["qa.variant"]
731: 	if variant == "" {
732: 		variant = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Execution.DefaultVariant)
733: 		variantSource = effective.Sources["execution.default_variant"]
734: 	}
735: 	parseDuration := func(field, value string) (time.Duration, error) {
736: 		duration, parseErr := time.ParseDuration(value)
737: 		if parseErr != nil {
738: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", field, parseErr)
739: 		}
740: 		return duration, nil
741: 	}
742: 	commandTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.command_timeout", c.CommandTimeout)
743: 	if err != nil {
744: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
745: 	}
746: 	shardTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.shard_timeout", c.ShardTimeout)
747: 	if err != nil {
748: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
749: 	}
750: 	runTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.run_timeout", c.RunTimeout)
751: 	if err != nil {
752: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
753: 	}
754: 	cleanupTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.cleanup_timeout", c.CleanupTimeout)
755: 	if err != nil {
756: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
757: 	}
758: 	sources := make([]sprint.QAEffectiveSource, 0, len(config.QAConfigFields()))
759: 	for _, field := range config.QAConfigFields() {
760: 		source := effective.Sources[field]
761: 		if field == "qa.model" {
762: 			source = modelSource
763: 		}
764: 		if field == "qa.variant" {
765: 			source = variantSource
766: 		}
767: 		sources = append(sources, sprint.QAEffectiveSource{Field: field, Source: source})
768: 	}
769: 	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].Field < sources[j].Field })
770: 	settings := sprint.QASettings{Runtime: sprint.StageRuntime{Model: model, Variant: variant}, Sources: sources, Budgets: sprint.QABudgets{
771: 		ChangedPaths: c.ChangedPaths, PrimaryShards: c.PrimaryShards, BoundaryShards: c.BoundaryShards,
772: 		FollowUpShards: c.FollowUpShards, TotalShards: c.TotalShards, PendingEntries: c.PendingEntries,
773: 		ChangedPathsPerShard: c.ChangedPathsPerShard, ContextPathsPerShard: c.ContextPathsPerShard,
774: 		ContextExpansions: c.ContextExpansions, PathsPerExpansion: c.PathsPerExpansion,
775: 		BehavioralConcernsPerShard: c.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, TheoriesPerShard: c.TheoriesPerShard,
776: 		IterationsPerAttempt: c.IterationsPerAttempt, CommandsPerAttempt: c.CommandsPerAttempt,
777: 		RuntimeRetries: c.RuntimeRetries, ConcurrentInvestigators: c.ConcurrentInvestigators,
778: 		CommandTimeout: commandTimeout, ShardTimeout: shardTimeout, RunTimeout: runTimeout,
779: 		CleanupTimeout: cleanupTimeout, CommandOutputBytes: c.CommandOutputBytes,
780: 		ShardOutputBytes: c.ShardOutputBytes, PromptBytes: c.PromptBytes,
781: 		RecentProgress: c.RecentProgress, RetainedAttempts: c.RetainedAttempts, StateBytes: c.StateBytes,
782: 	}}
783: 	if err := sprint.ValidateQASettings(settings); err != nil {
784: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
785: 	}
786: 	return settings, nil
787: }

795: func renderSprintRuntimeProgress(deps dependencies) func(sprint.RuntimeProgress) {
796: 	var mu sync.Mutex
797: 	return func(progress sprint.RuntimeProgress) {
798: 		if !runtimeEventIsProgress(progress.Event) {
799: 			return
800: 		}
801: 		mu.Lock()
802: 		defer mu.Unlock()

944: func mapSprintError(prefix string, err error) error {
945: 	var projectRef project.RefError
946: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
947: 	switch {
948: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
949: 		return classified(ExitCancel, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
950: 	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
951: 		return classified(ExitRuntime, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
952: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict):
953: 		return classified(ExitPartial, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
954: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported):
955: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
956: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported):
957: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
958: 	case errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef):
959: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
960: 	default:
961: 		return classified(ExitWorkspace, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
962: 	}
963: }

979: func addSprintStageOverride(overrides map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, flag, spec string) (map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, error) {
980: 	stageName, value, found := strings.Cut(spec, "=")
981: 	stageName = strings.TrimSpace(stageName)
982: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
983: 	if !found || stageName == "" || value == "" {
984: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value> (for example %sexecute=provider/model)", flag, flag)
985: 	}
986: 	stage, ok := sprintStageOverrideTargets[stageName]
987: 	if !ok {
988: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s: unsupported stage %q", flag, stageName)
989: 	}
990: 	if overrides == nil {
991: 		overrides = map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime{}
992: 	}
993: 	override := overrides[stage]
994: 	if flag == "--stage-model" {
995: 		override.Model = value
996: 	} else {
997: 		override.Variant = value
998: 	}
999: 	overrides[stage] = override
1000: 	return overrides, nil
1001: }

1010: 			var err error

1012: 			if err != nil {
1013: 				return req, err

1015: 			continue
1016: 		}
1017: 		switch args[i] {

1019: 			if i+1 >= len(args) {
1020: 				return req, fmt.Errorf("--to requires a stage")

1022: 			req.To = sprint.PlanningStage(args[i+1])
1023: 			i++
1024: 		case "--dry-run":

1026: 		case "--model":

1030: 			i++

1057: 			}
1058: 			i++

1060: 		default:

1062: 		}

1235: func renderSprintStatus(deps dependencies, status sprint.StatusSummary) {

1238: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "Sprint root: %s\n", status.SprintRoot)
1239: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "Flow state: %s\n", status.FlowStatePath)
1240: 	fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Stages:")
1241: 	for _, stage := range status.Stages {
1242: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  %s: %s (%s)", stage.Stage, stage.Status, stage.Path)
1243: 		if stage.LatestOutcome != "" {
1244: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, " latest=%s", stage.LatestOutcome)
1245: 		}
1246: 		if stage.Error != "" {
1247: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, " error=%q", stage.Error)
1248: 		}
1249: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout)
1250: 	}
1251: 	fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Execute:")
1252: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  summary: %s\n", status.ExecutePath)
1253: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  run state: %s\n", status.RunStatePath)
1254: 	if status.ExecuteState == nil {
1255: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "  status: not started")
1256: 	} else {
1257: 		counts := map[sprint.ExecuteTaskStatus]int{}
1258: 		for _, task := range status.ExecuteState.Tasks {
1259: 			counts[task.Status]++
1260: 		}
1261: 		for _, state := range sprint.ExecuteTaskStatuses() {
1262: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  %s: %d\n", state, counts[state])
1263: 		}
1264: 	}
1265: 	fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Conformance Review:")
1266: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  artifact: %s\n", status.ReviewPath)
1267: 	if status.Review == nil {
1268: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "  status: not started")
1269: 	} else {
1270: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  status: %s\n  verdict: %s\n  stale: %t\n  progress: %d/%d\n", status.Review.Status, status.Review.Verdict, status.Review.Stale, status.Review.Completed, status.Review.Total)
1271: 	}
1272: 	fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Smoke:")
1273: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  artifact: %s\n", status.SmokePath)

1275: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "  status: not started")

1278: 	}
1279: 	renderSprintVerification(deps, status.Verification)

352: 			result, err = execService.Execute(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
353: 		}
354: 		err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
355: 		renderSprintExecute(deps, result)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			if len(result.Findings) > 0 {
358: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
359: 			}
360: 			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "failed tasks") {
361: 				return classified(ExitPartial, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
362: 			}
363: 			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "runtime") {
364: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.execute: %w", err)
365: 			}
366: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.execute", err)
367: 		}
368: 		return nil
369: 	case "qa":
370: 		qa, settingsErr := qaSettings(effective)
371: 		if settingsErr != nil {
372: 			return classified(ExitConfig, "qa.config: %w", settingsErr)
373: 		}
374: 		qaService := service.WithQASettings(qa)
375: 		qaCommand, parseErr := parseSprintQAArgs(args[3:])
376: 		if parseErr != nil {
377: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.qa: %w", parseErr)
378: 		}
379: 		operationStatus := "ok"
380: 		var qaResult QAResult
381: 		var runErr error
382: 		switch qaCommand.Action {
383: 		case "map":
384: 			mapped, mapErr := qaService.QAMap(args[0], args[1])
385: 			runErr = mapErr
386: 			if mapErr == nil {
387: 				qaResult = qaMapProjection(mapped.Map)
388: 			}
389: 		case "status":
390: 			snapshot, statusErr := qaService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
391: 			runErr = statusErr
392: 			if statusErr == nil {
393: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
394: 			}
395: 		case "recover":
396: 			snapshot, recoverErr := qaService.RecoverQA(deps.ctx, args[0], args[1])
397: 			runErr = recoverErr
398: 			if recoverErr == nil {
399: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
400: 			}
401: 		case "cancel":
402: 			repository, _, repositoryErr := runRepository(deps)
403: 			if repositoryErr != nil {
404: 				runErr = repositoryErr
405: 				break
406: 			}
407: 			useCases := dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, runs: repositoryRunUseCases{repository: repository}}
408: 			cancelled, cancelErr := useCases.CancelQA(deps.ctx, QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], RunID: qaCommand.RunID})
409: 			runErr = cancelErr
410: 			qaResult = cancelled.QA
411: 			if cancelErr == nil {
412: 				qaResult.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("cancellation requested=%t run=%s; %s", cancelled.Requested, cancelled.Run.RunID, qaResult.NextAction)
413: 			}
414: 		case "run", "resume":
415: 			kind := OperationQAStart
416: 			if qaCommand.Action == "resume" {
417: 				kind = OperationQAResume
418: 			}
419: 			durable, durableErr := beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: kind, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Task: qaCommand.Shard})
420: 			if durableErr != nil {
421: 				runErr = durableErr
422: 				break
423: 			}
424: 			token, fence, ownershipErr := durable.QAWriterToken()
425: 			if ownershipErr != nil {
426: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, ownershipErr)
427: 				break
428: 			}
429: 			runtimeService, serviceErr := sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
430: 			if serviceErr != nil {
431: 				runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, serviceErr)
432: 				break
433: 			}
434: 			runtimeService = runtimeService.WithQAWriterFence(fence)
435: 			_, qaErr := runtimeService.RunQA(durable.Context(), args[0], args[1], sprint.QARunRequest{Resume: qaCommand.Action == "resume", FocusShard: qaCommand.Shard, WriterToken: token, Progress: func(progress sprint.QAProgress) {
436: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[qa] %s %d/%d", progress.Phase, progress.Completed, progress.Total)
437: 				if progress.ShardID != "" {
438: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.ShardID)
439: 				}
440: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", config.RedactValue("qa.progress", progress.Message))
441: 			}})
442: 			runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, qaErr)
443: 			snapshot, statusErr := runtimeService.QAStatus(args[0], args[1])
444: 			if statusErr == nil {
445: 				qaResult = qaSnapshotProjection(snapshot)
446: 			} else {
447: 				runErr = errors.Join(runErr, statusErr)
448: 			}
449: 		}
450: 		if runErr != nil {
451: 			operationStatus = "failed"
452: 		}
453: 		qaResult = (dashboardUseCases{root: root.Path, qaSettings: qa, readOnly: true}).withQAConformanceReview(QARequest{Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1]}, qaResult)
454: 		if qaCommand.JSON {
455: 			payload := map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.qa", "status": operationStatus, "result": qaResult}
456: 			if runErr != nil {
457: 				payload["error"] = stableQACommandError(mapQACommandError(runErr), runErr, qaResult)
458: 			}
459: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(payload)
460: 		} else {
461: 			renderSprintQA(deps, qaResult)
462: 		}
463: 		if runErr != nil {
464: 			return mapQACommandError(runErr)
465: 		}
466: 		return nil
467: 	case "review":
468: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintReviewArgs(args[3:])
469: 		if err != nil {
470: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.review: %w", err)
471: 		}
472: 		reviewService := service
473: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
474: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
475: 		if !req.DryRun {
476: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.ReviewProgress) {
477: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[sprint] Conformance Review coverage %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
478: 				if progress.CoverageID != "" {
479: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %s", progress.CoverageID)
480: 				}
481: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, ": %s\n", progress.Message)
482: 			}
483: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationReviewStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "review", RestartReview: req.Restart})
484: 			if err != nil {
485: 				return err
486: 			}
487: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
488: 			reviewService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
489: 			if err != nil {
490: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 		result, runErr := reviewService.Review(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
494: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
495: 		if jsonOut {
496: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.review", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
497: 		} else {
498: 			renderSprintReview(deps, result)
499: 		}
500: 		if runErr != nil {
501: 			if result.Verdict == sprint.ReviewFail {
502: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
503: 			}
504: 			if result.Status == sprint.ReviewBlocked {
505: 				return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
506: 			}
507: 			if strings.Contains(runErr.Error(), "runtime") {
508: 				return classified(ExitRuntime, "sprint.review: %w", runErr)
509: 			}
510: 			return mapSprintError("sprint.review", runErr)
511: 		}
512: 		return nil
513: 	case "smoke":
514: 		req, jsonOut, err := parseSprintSmokeArgs(args[3:])
515: 		if err != nil {
516: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: %w", err)
517: 		}
518: 		if !req.DryRun && !req.NonInteractive {
519: 			return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint.smoke: --yes is required for non-interactive external harness execution")
520: 		}
521: 		if !req.DryRun {
522: 			req.Progress = func(progress sprint.SmokeProgress) {
523: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, "[smoke] %-20s", progress.Phase)
524: 				if progress.Test != "" {
525: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " test=%s", progress.Test)
526: 				} else if progress.Suite != "" {
527: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " suite=%s", progress.Suite)
528: 				}
529: 				if progress.Total > 0 {
530: 					fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " %d/%d", progress.Completed, progress.Total)
531: 				}
532: 				fmt.Fprintf(deps.stderr, " | %s\n", config.RedactValue("smoke.progress", progress.Message))
533: 			}
534: 		}
535: 		smokeService := service
536: 		runCtx := deps.ctx
537: 		var durable *durableCLICommand
538: 		if !req.DryRun {
539: 			durable, err = beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationSmokeStart, Project: args[0], Sprint: args[1], Stage: "smoke", Level: string(req.Level), Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test})
540: 			if err != nil {
541: 				return err
542: 			}
543: 			runCtx = durable.Context()
544: 			smokeService, err = sprintRuntimeService(deps, root)
545: 			if err != nil {
546: 				return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
547: 			}
548: 		}
549: 		result, runErr := smokeService.RunSmoke(runCtx, args[0], args[1], req)
550: 		runErr = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, runErr)
551: 		if jsonOut {
552: 			_ = json.NewEncoder(deps.stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema_version": 1, "operation": "sprint.smoke", "status": result.Status, "result": result})
553: 		} else {
554: 			renderSprintSmoke(deps, result)
555: 		}
556: 		if runErr != nil {
557: 			return mapSmokeError(runErr)
558: 		}
559: 		if result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeFailVerdict || result.Verdict == sprint.SmokeBlockedVerdict {
560: 			return classified(ExitValidation, "sprint.smoke: verdict %s; %s", result.Verdict, result.NextAction)
561: 		}
562: 		return nil
563: 	default:
564: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "sprint: unsupported command %q", args[2])
565: 	}
566: }

568: func stripFlag(args []string, flag string) ([]string, bool) {
569: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(args))
570: 	found := false
571: 	for _, arg := range args {
572: 		if arg == flag {
573: 			found = true
574: 			continue
575: 		}
576: 		out = append(out, arg)
577: 	}

588: func parseSprintQAArgs(args []string) (sprintQACommand, error) {
589: 	command := sprintQACommand{Action: "run"}
590: 	if len(args) > 0 {
591: 		switch args[0] {
592: 		case "status", "resume", "cancel", "recover":
593: 			command.Action = args[0]
594: 			args = args[1:]
595: 		}
596: 	}
597: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
598: 		switch args[i] {
599: 		case "--dry-run":
600: 			if command.Action != "run" {
601: 				return command, fmt.Errorf("--dry-run cannot be combined with %s", command.Action)
602: 			}
603: 			command.Action = "map"
604: 		case "--json":
605: 			command.JSON = true
606: 		case "--shard":
607: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
608: 				return command, errors.New("--shard requires a map-owned shard ID")
609: 			}
610: 			command.Shard = args[i+1]
611: 			i++
612: 		case "--run":
613: 			if i+1 >= len(args) || strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
614: 				return command, errors.New("--run requires a durable run ID")
615: 			}
616: 			command.RunID = args[i+1]
617: 			i++
618: 		default:
619: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("unknown QA argument %q", args[i])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 	switch command.Action {
623: 	case "run", "resume":
624: 		if command.RunID != "" {
625: 			return command, errors.New("--run is valid only with qa cancel")
626: 		}
627: 	case "cancel":
628: 		if command.RunID == "" {
629: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel requires --run")
630: 		}
631: 		if command.Shard != "" {
632: 			return command, errors.New("qa cancel does not accept --shard")
633: 		}
634: 	case "map", "status", "recover":
635: 		if command.Shard != "" || command.RunID != "" {
636: 			return command, fmt.Errorf("qa %s does not accept --shard or --run", command.Action)
637: 		}
638: 	}
639: 	return command, nil
640: }

642: func renderSprintQA(deps dependencies, result QAResult) {
643: 	if result.Phase == string(sprint.QAPhaseCompleted) {
644: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA completed")
645: 	} else {
646: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Read-only QA")
647: 	}
648: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  sprint: %s/%s\n  phase: %s\n  fresh: %t\n", result.Project, result.Sprint, result.Phase, result.Fresh)
649: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  Conformance Review: status=%s verdict=%s fresh=%t\n", result.ConformanceReviewStatus, result.ConformanceReviewVerdict, result.ConformanceReviewFresh)
650: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  coverage: %d/%d changed paths\n  shards: %d/%d\n", result.CoveredPaths, result.ChangedPaths, result.CompletedShards, result.TotalShards)
651: 	for _, outcome := range []string{"confirmed", "refuted", "invalid", "inconclusive", "blocked", "cross_shard", "not_applicable"} {
652: 		if count := result.OutcomeTotals[outcome]; count > 0 {
653: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  theories.%s: %d\n", outcome, count)
654: 		}
655: 	}
656: 	if result.Blocker != nil {
657: 		fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  blocker: %s (%s)\n", result.Blocker.Summary, result.Blocker.Category)
658: 	}
659: 	fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  next: %s\n", result.NextAction)
660: }

662: func mapQACommandError(err error) error {
663: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
664: 		code := "qa.cancelled"
665: 		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
666: 			code = "qa.deadline_exceeded"
667: 		}
668: 		return classedError{class: ExitPartial, code: code, err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
669: 	}
670: 	if typed, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
671: 		class := ExitValidation
672: 		switch typed.Category {
673: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
674: 			class = ExitRuntime
675: 		}
676: 		return classedError{class: class, code: "qa." + string(typed.Category), err: fmt.Errorf("sprint.qa: %w", err)}
677: 	}
678: 	return mapSprintError("sprint.qa", err)
679: }

692: 		return sprint.Service{}, classified(ExitConfig, "runtime.config: %w", err)

695: 	if err != nil {
696: 		return sprint.Service{}, classified(ExitRuntime, "runtime.init: %w", err)

711: }

713: func qaSettings(effective config.Effective) (sprint.QASettings, error) {
714: 	c := effective.Config.QA
715: 	model := strings.TrimSpace(c.Model)
716: 	modelSource := effective.Sources["qa.model"]
717: 	if model == "" {
718: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.ReviewModel)
719: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.review_model"]
720: 	}
721: 	if model == "" {
722: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Planning.PlanModel)
723: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["planning.plan_model"]
724: 	}
725: 	if model == "" {
726: 		model = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Models.Default)
727: 		modelSource = effective.Sources["models.default"]
728: 	}
729: 	variant := strings.TrimSpace(c.Variant)
730: 	variantSource := effective.Sources["qa.variant"]
731: 	if variant == "" {
732: 		variant = strings.TrimSpace(effective.Config.Execution.DefaultVariant)
733: 		variantSource = effective.Sources["execution.default_variant"]
734: 	}
735: 	parseDuration := func(field, value string) (time.Duration, error) {
736: 		duration, parseErr := time.ParseDuration(value)
737: 		if parseErr != nil {
738: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", field, parseErr)
739: 		}
740: 		return duration, nil
741: 	}
742: 	commandTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.command_timeout", c.CommandTimeout)
743: 	if err != nil {
744: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
745: 	}
746: 	shardTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.shard_timeout", c.ShardTimeout)
747: 	if err != nil {
748: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
749: 	}
750: 	runTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.run_timeout", c.RunTimeout)
751: 	if err != nil {
752: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
753: 	}
754: 	cleanupTimeout, err := parseDuration("qa.cleanup_timeout", c.CleanupTimeout)
755: 	if err != nil {
756: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
757: 	}
758: 	sources := make([]sprint.QAEffectiveSource, 0, len(config.QAConfigFields()))
759: 	for _, field := range config.QAConfigFields() {
760: 		source := effective.Sources[field]
761: 		if field == "qa.model" {
762: 			source = modelSource
763: 		}
764: 		if field == "qa.variant" {
765: 			source = variantSource
766: 		}
767: 		sources = append(sources, sprint.QAEffectiveSource{Field: field, Source: source})
768: 	}
769: 	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].Field < sources[j].Field })
770: 	settings := sprint.QASettings{Runtime: sprint.StageRuntime{Model: model, Variant: variant}, Sources: sources, Budgets: sprint.QABudgets{
771: 		ChangedPaths: c.ChangedPaths, PrimaryShards: c.PrimaryShards, BoundaryShards: c.BoundaryShards,
772: 		FollowUpShards: c.FollowUpShards, TotalShards: c.TotalShards, PendingEntries: c.PendingEntries,
773: 		ChangedPathsPerShard: c.ChangedPathsPerShard, ContextPathsPerShard: c.ContextPathsPerShard,
774: 		ContextExpansions: c.ContextExpansions, PathsPerExpansion: c.PathsPerExpansion,
775: 		BehavioralConcernsPerShard: c.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, TheoriesPerShard: c.TheoriesPerShard,
776: 		IterationsPerAttempt: c.IterationsPerAttempt, CommandsPerAttempt: c.CommandsPerAttempt,
777: 		RuntimeRetries: c.RuntimeRetries, ConcurrentInvestigators: c.ConcurrentInvestigators,
778: 		CommandTimeout: commandTimeout, ShardTimeout: shardTimeout, RunTimeout: runTimeout,
779: 		CleanupTimeout: cleanupTimeout, CommandOutputBytes: c.CommandOutputBytes,
780: 		ShardOutputBytes: c.ShardOutputBytes, PromptBytes: c.PromptBytes,
781: 		RecentProgress: c.RecentProgress, RetainedAttempts: c.RetainedAttempts, StateBytes: c.StateBytes,
782: 	}}
783: 	if err := sprint.ValidateQASettings(settings); err != nil {
784: 		return sprint.QASettings{}, err
785: 	}
786: 	return settings, nil
787: }

944: func mapSprintError(prefix string, err error) error {
945: 	var projectRef project.RefError
946: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
947: 	switch {
948: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
949: 		return classified(ExitCancel, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
950: 	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
951: 		return classified(ExitRuntime, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
952: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict):
953: 		return classified(ExitPartial, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
954: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported):
955: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
956: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported):
957: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
958: 	case errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef):
959: 		return classified(ExitValidation, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
960: 	default:
961: 		return classified(ExitWorkspace, "%s: %w", prefix, err)
962: 	}
963: }

979: func addSprintStageOverride(overrides map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, flag, spec string) (map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime, error) {
980: 	stageName, value, found := strings.Cut(spec, "=")
981: 	stageName = strings.TrimSpace(stageName)
982: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
983: 	if !found || stageName == "" || value == "" {
984: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s requires <stage>=<value> (for example %sexecute=provider/model)", flag, flag)
985: 	}
986: 	stage, ok := sprintStageOverrideTargets[stageName]
987: 	if !ok {
988: 		return overrides, fmt.Errorf("%s: unsupported stage %q", flag, stageName)
989: 	}
990: 	if overrides == nil {
991: 		overrides = map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime{}
992: 	}
993: 	override := overrides[stage]
994: 	if flag == "--stage-model" {
995: 		override.Model = value
996: 	} else {
997: 		override.Variant = value
998: 	}
999: 	overrides[stage] = override
1000: 	return overrides, nil
1001: }

158: func (m *durableOperationManager) RecordOperationEvent(ctx context.Context, runID string, event OperationEvent) (bool, error) {

160: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
161: 	m.mu.Unlock()
162: 	if owned == nil {
163: 		return false, runcontrol.ErrNotFound
164: 	}
165: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
166: 	defer owned.eventMu.Unlock()

168: 	if event.State == OperationFailed {
169: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
170: 	}
171: 	key := string(eventType) + "\x00" + event.Stage + "\x00" + event.Task + "\x00" + event.PhaseState + "\x00" + event.SafeSummary + "\x00" + event.EventType + "\x00" + event.EventKind + "\x00" + event.Tool + "\x00" + event.Reason + "\x00" + event.Detail

173: 	elapsed := now.Sub(owned.progressAt)

175: 		if owned.omitted == 0 {
176: 			owned.omittedFirst = now
177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++
179: 		owned.omittedLast = now
180: 		return false, nil
181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),

186: 	for key, value := range map[string]string{

188: 		"tool_call_id": event.ToolCallID, "tool_status": event.ToolStatus,
189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,
191: 	} {

194: 		}
195: 	}

197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()

216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil

223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return
247: 			}
248: 			if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()
251: 					return
252: 				}
253: 				lastHeartbeat = now
254: 			}
255: 			if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
256: 				if _, err := m.repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}
260: 				lastReconcile = now
261: 			}
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: }
265: 
266: func (m *durableOperationManager) FinishOperation(ctx context.Context, runID string, state OperationState, runErr error) error {
267: 	m.mu.Lock()
268: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}
274: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}
282: 	owned.eventMu.Unlock()
283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:
294: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalFailed, "operation failed"
295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"
297: 	}
298: 	_, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
299: 	return err

177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++

181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),

189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,

194: 		}
195: 	}

197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()
215: 		return false, err
216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil

223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return
247: 			}
248: 			if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()
251: 					return
252: 				}
253: 				lastHeartbeat = now
254: 			}
255: 			if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
256: 				if _, err := m.repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}
260: 				lastReconcile = now
261: 			}
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: }

266: func (m *durableOperationManager) FinishOperation(ctx context.Context, runID string, state OperationState, runErr error) error {
267: 	m.mu.Lock()
268: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}
274: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}
282: 	owned.eventMu.Unlock()
283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:
294: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalFailed, "operation failed"
295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"
297: 	}
298: 	_, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
299: 	return err

75: 			return nil
76: 		}

79: 		}
80: 		return nil
81: 	case len(args) == 2 && args[1] == "list":

85: 		}

91: 		for _, source := range listing.Sources {
92: 			applicability := "all"

102: 		for _, dimension := range listing.Dimensions {
103: 			fmt.Fprintf(deps.stdout, "  %s %s %s\n", dimension.Number, dimension.Slug, dimension.File)
104: 		}
105: 		fmt.Fprintln(deps.stdout, "Dimension order:")

115: 	case args[0] == "list":

118: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "study: expected 'init', 'list', '<study> list', '<study> summary', '<study> validate', '<study> status', '<study> runs', '<study> run-loop', '<study> run-all', '<study> run', '<study> synthesize', or '<study> prompt'")

197: func runStudyRunLoop(deps dependencies, root workspace.Root, studyRef string, args []string) error {
198: 	if len(args) == 1 && (args[0] == "--help" || args[0] == "-h") {
199: 		_, err := deps.stdout.Write([]byte(studyRunLoopHelp()))
200: 		return err
201: 	}
202: 	flags, err := parseRunLoopArgs(args)
203: 	if err != nil {
204: 		return classified(ExitUsage, "study run-loop: %w", err)
205: 	}
206: 	if flags.reset {
207: 		if err := confirmRunLoopReplacement(deps, root.Path, studyRef, flags); err != nil {
208: 			return err
209: 		}
210: 	}
211: 	durable, err := beginDurableCLICommand(deps, OperationRequest{Kind: OperationStudyResume, Study: studyRef, Parallelism: operationParallelism(flags.parallelism)})
212: 	if err != nil {
213: 		return err
214: 	}
215: 	service, parallelism, summary, err := runLoopService(deps, root, flags)
216: 	if err != nil {
217: 		return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
218: 	}
219: 	command := append([]string{"ultraplan", "study", studyRef, "run-loop"}, args...)
220: 	result, err := service.RunLoop(durable.Context(), study.RunLoopRequest{
221: 		StudyRef:      studyRef,
222: 		DimensionRefs: flags.dimensions,
223: 		SourceRefs:    flags.sources,
224: 		Parallelism:   parallelism,
225: 		Model:         studyModelOverride(deps, flags.model),
226: 		Config:        summary,
227: 		Command:       command,
228: 		ForceUnlock:   flags.forceUnlock,
229: 		Continue:      flags.continueRun,
230: 		Reset:         flags.reset,
231: 		Progress:      renderRunLoopProgress(deps, root.Path),
232: 	})
233: 	err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err)
234: 	if err != nil {
235: 		return mapStudyRunLoopError(err)
236: 	}
237: 	renderRunLoopResult(deps, root.Path, result)
238: 	return classifyRunAllResult(study.RunAllResult{Status: result.Status})
239: }
